items.name: smart-banner
items.title: Smart Banner
items.description: Smart App Banner for iOS and Android styled with Tailwind and shadcn/ui. The logic comes from the smartbanner-tsx package.
items.docs: Pass your app IDs with the appId prop or add the apple-itunes-app / google-play-app meta tags. Preview on desktop with force="ios" or force="android". Docs: https://madiyar.github.io/smartbanner-tsx/#shadcn
